title: Elodie and the Well
author: Oscar Kavanagh
blurb: Astrid Sterling, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
